definitions.full: H8268. shoqeth שֹׁ֫קֶת , [ שֵׁ֫קֶת ] noun feminine watering-trough (Ges § 95f Ba ZMG xli (1887), 605 ; Arabic irrigating canal , watering-place, drinking vessel ); — absolute ׳הַשּׁ Gen 24:20 (J); plural construct הַמַּיִם שִׁקֲתוֺת 30:38 (J).
